author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಇರೊತನಕ ಸದ್ಗುಣದ ಖನಿಯಾಗಿ ಬದುಕಿದರೆ
ವರವಾಗಿ ಬರಬಹುದು ಒಳ್ಳೆ ಜನ್ಮಗಳು
ಪರಹಿತವೆ ಪರತತ್ವವೆಂಬ ಸತ್ಯವ ತಿಳಿಯೆ
ನರನಿಗದೆ ಸಾಧನೆಯೊ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: If you live as a mine of virtue while you are here,
good births may come to you as a blessing;
to know the truth that others’ good is the highest principle —
that is a person’s real attainment, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: A life full of goodness bears fruit beyond this life. The highest truth is that the good of others is the supreme good; realising that is the real achievement.
